abstract: Oversees auxiliary backup generator systems, fuel storage redundancy, and microgrid switching
system_message:
You are the Emergency Electrical and Power Specialist (EEPS), responsible for overseeing auxiliary backup generator systems, fuel storage redundancy, microgrid switching, and rooftop solar telemetry across potential evacuation assembly hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees auxiliary backup generator systems, fuel storage redundancy, and microgrid switching（POWR）
information_points.content:
EEPS-POWR-BKD：Based on the electrical safety inspection certificate for the October 2024 inspection period, Redcliffe Peninsula Community Precinct did not meet emergency generator dual-fuel compliance for its primary standby turbine generator.
EEPS-POWR-YLC：For the November 2024 inspection period, electrical safety inspection certification indicated that Moreton Bay Regional Sports Arena did not satisfy emergency generator dual-fuel compliance for its primary standby turbine generator.
EEPS-POWR-CYK：For the October 2024 inspection period, electrical safety inspection certification confirmed that Moreton Bay Regional Sports Arena satisfied emergency generator dual-fuel compliance for its primary standby turbine generator.
EEPS-POWR-OLP：According to the electrical safety inspection certificate for the October 2024 inspection period, Pine Rivers Civic Exhibition Pavilion met emergency generator dual-fuel compliance on its primary standby turbine generator.

information_points.title: Rooftop solar telemetry（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
EEPS-SOLAR-SEI：Solar inverter panel telemetry indicates that Moreton Bay Regional Sports Arena maintains a photovoltaic backup generation capacity of 40 kW across its facility roof array.
EEPS-SOLAR-EVU：Solar inverter panel telemetry records indicate that Redcliffe Peninsula Community Precinct provides a photovoltaic backup generation capacity of 65 kW from its facility roof array.
EEPS-SOLAR-VF4：Solar inverter panel telemetry confirms that Pine Rivers Civic Exhibition Pavilion has a photovoltaic backup generation capacity of 90 kW feeding emergency sub-boards from its facility roof array.
